kind: not a race): the very first "join" message locks the party at 1 regardless of how many friends are about to connect. So this deployed instance is reliably SOLO-ONLY right now even though logic.js's setup()/enemy-scaling already supports 2-4 players and was verified correct in isolation (see run_sim.mjs results below). Getting real multi-human co-op requires either a fixed minPlayers=N (breaks solo) or a Tier-2 custom server.js with an explicit host-controlled lobby/ready-up step - flagged to the user as the next iteration rather than silently shipping unreliable co-op.
